tools.name: dxf-prep/prepare.ps1
tools.description: One-command ETABS DXF preparation: CLI + validator + AutoCAD check + preview.
tools.description_full: Prepares one DXF file (or every *.dxf directly inside a folder) for ETABS import. Auto-detection is the default: entities classify by geometry with layer names as hints, so any office style works with no layer options. For each input it runs the cached DxfPrep CLI, validates the output, opens it with AutoCAD accoreconsole, renders a preview PNG, prints one compact summary table, and upserts <OutDir>\prep-report.md (rows accumulate across runs, keyed by file stem). Exits non-zero when any file fails. Input files are never modified.
tools.input_schema_note: Converted from the PowerShell param() block: [string]->string, [double]->number, [switch]->boolean, ValidateSet->enum, Mandatory->required.
tools.annotations_note: Command-line tools declare no MCP annotations.

changes_host_units.note: Metres in the output DXF (documented), no host unit setting.

timeout.note: No timeout is set by the script; the harness must bound the process (Job Object, process/11 and 11 section 9).

tools.exit_codes: 0 ok; 1 any file failed or no input; CLI: 0/1/2/3
notes: Writes <OutDir>/<stem>.dxf, <stem>.grids.json, preview PNG and prep-report.md; never modifies the input DXF.

Calls the cached DxfPrep CLI (dotnet publish on first use or when sources are newer), a Python validator, AutoCAD accoreconsole (path fixed to AutoCAD 2023 in the script) and a Python preview renderer: needs a Windows machine with AutoCAD (needs local test).
Output geometry is in metres with the lowest-left grid intersection at the origin (docs/dxf-prep/README.md, Origin option).
Exit code is non-zero on any failure (README); the CLI itself uses 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 unreadable input, 3 failed (Program.cs:34-37).

tools.name: dxf-prep/inspect.ps1
tools.description: Fast DXF classification preview: no output DXF, just the verdicts plus a PNG.
tools.description_full: Runs the cached DxfPrep CLI in --inspect mode on one DXF file (or every *.dxf directly inside a folder): prints per-layer entity counts with the auto classification and confidence per layer/class, plus warnings for ambiguous items. Writes <stem>.classify.json (the raw verdicts) and <stem>.classify.png, a preview coloured by class. Input files are never modified. Use this first for an unknown office, then prepare with -Profile/-SaveProfile.

tools.name: etabs-model/build.ps1
tools.description: One-command ETABS model from prepared DXFs: generate e2k, save EDB, analyze, verify.
tools.description_full: Reads a model-config.json plus prepared level DXFs, writes <out>.e2k, then (unless -NoEtabs) opens it in a self-launched hidden ETABS 22 instance, saves <out>.EDB, runs the analysis, checks the saved model, exits only that instance, prints a compact summary, and writes model-report.md next to the output. Exits non-zero on any failure. The template is never modified.
tools.input_schema_note: Converted from the PowerShell param() block: [string]->string, [double]->number, [switch]->boolean, ValidateSet->enum, Mandatory->required.
tools.annotations_note: Command-line tools declare no MCP annotations.

changes_host_units.note: Uses the template's units (kN, m, C documented) in a hidden instance it launched; the user's ETABS session is never touched.

timeout.source: 04_Deployments/Sasaah.Etabs.ModelFromDxf.Cli/Program.cs:194 (ETABS call timeout inside the CLI); the process itself has no overall timeout

notes: Generates <out>.e2k, launches its own hidden ETABS instance, saves <out>.EDB, RUNS THE ANALYSIS, verifies the saved model, exits only the instance it launched, writes model-report.md (docs/etabs-model/README.md).
The ETABS session inside the CLI uses CallTimeoutSec 300 (04_Deployments/Sasaah.Etabs.ModelFromDxf.Cli/Program.cs:194) instead of the server default of 120.
Template .e2k is ETABS 22 text in kN/m/C and is read-only; the model units follow the template (documented).
Needs ETABS 22 installed: needs local test. -NoEtabs stops after writing the e2k.
Exit codes of the CLI: 0 ok, 1 failure ('FAIL: ...'), 2 usage (Program.cs:41-65).

tools.name: etabs-model/classify-columns.ps1
tools.description: Reaction-based column sizing: joins base reactions (footings.json from the footing-design tool) with old sections (current .e2k) into column-overrides.json.
tools.description_full: Reads per-position factored axial loads (1.2D+1.6L, ACI 318 gravity combo as combined by ReactionCombiner) and assigns every base position one of 20x45 / 20x55 / 20x65 by declared thresholds. Orientation is NOT decided here: the builder keeps each column's DXF direction (ANG), the override only changes the long side. The JSON also carries the old-section map and the assumption/threshold text the model CLI pastes into model-report.md.

tools.name: dxf-prep/validate_etabs_dxf.py
tools.description: Validate a prepared ETABS DXF against its grid sidecar
tools.description_full: Validate a prepared ETABS DXF against its grid sidecar. Usage: python tools/dxf-prep/validate_etabs_dxf.py <output.dxf> [<grids.json>] [--expected-columns 34] [--expect-sizes "0.2x0.45,0.55x0.2,..."] [--strict-connectivity] Checks (exit non-zero with a message on the first failure): - modelspace holds exactly <expected-columns> closed LWPOLYLINEs on layer اعمده; - every column bbox centre is within 1e-6 of a translated grid intersection; - every column bbox size matches one entry of --expect-sizes (orientation free, within 1e-3) when that option is given; - every LINE on layer beams is longer than zero; - every beam end is either a grid intersection (within 1e-6) or lies on another beam (within 1e-6); - no duplicate beams (same endpoints either direction, within 1e-6); - the minimum grid intersection is at (0, 0) within 1e-6; - $INSUNITS is 6 (metres).
